title: Home Assistant Material: AC Defender as an integration

Main.dc.html.title: AC Defender as an integration: setup, the defender page, guards

n-acd.text: The reference is a separate web app with its own worker. As an integration it lives inside the home: set up from Add integration, one device per defended air conditioner, its guards as entities that automations can read and switch, and one page for the whole picture. No second sign-in, no separate server.
